scope: Occlusion-aware persistent late grasp repair and real-human comparison
summary: A two-frame, 632-pixel source-supported hand-layer repair raises the declared 497-643 persistent visual-grasp interval from 145/147 to 147/147 and survives complete hand-erasure attacks, while independent late hand-sharpness and structure-ghost gates keep the overall candidate PARTIAL.
evidence: The final video is independently audited as 660 frames, 1280x720, 24 fps, and 27.5 seconds with SHA-256 5a93bf9a73dd702e188a2e7b61bdc1a8e6ba6b1dcf7a614a8f065a6b7197cf08.
Persistent grasp passes 147/147 frames over [497, 644), source hold is observable on 147/147, and complete hand erasure is rejected on 147/147.
Late projected contact remains 11/11 and late hand replacement coverage violates its anchor-fitted limit in only 3/180 frames.
The targeted repair changes 632 pixels across frames 572 and 573 in 26.9688 seconds at 24.4727 FPS; their occlusion-corridor coverage rises to 0.8409 and 0.8333 without changing the fixed 0.80 gate.
The final full-resolution audit takes 281.3215 seconds at 2.3468 FPS; color, topology, contact, and persistent-grasp erasure attacks pass.
A 660-frame side-by-side real-human versus robot comparison and poster are generated from the exact audited video.
lessons: Persistent interaction state needs an occlusion-surviving object track distinct from the z-order-resolved visible object layer.
A dense hold interval catches failures that 11 sparse contact frames cannot, and a two-frame source-supported repair can resolve them without regenerating the full sequence.
Independent sharpness and adversarial structure gates must remain blocking even when the task-specific grasp gate reaches 100 percent.
limitations: Late hand edge energy still violates its frozen lower gate in 22/180 frames.
The structure-ghost attack remains undetected at p05 delta 0.6296 below the fixed 0.75 threshold.
The visual grasp contract is camera-frame evidence only; it does not prove metric depth, contact force, force closure, collision safety, or real-robot execution.
next_actions: Train or route a native-resolution hand-structure residual model and promote only after the frozen late sharpness and structure-ghost attack gates pass.
